verdict.rationale: Lago's self-hosted Docker deployment (lago-docs-11) implicitly lets a user control where their data resides by choosing their own infrastructure/region, but there is no explicit documentation of a region-selection feature, data-residency guarantees, or compliance certifications for the managed/cloud offering. missing for 10: explicit data-residency/region-selection feature docs, compliance certifications (e.g., GDPR/SOC2 region controls), managed-cloud region options.
